question: For the patients with an abnormal activated partial prothrom bin time, how many of them does not have thrombosis?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "patient_aptt_thrombosis" AS SELECT CAST(t3.id AS BIGINT) AS patient_id, t3.date AS test_date, t3.aptt AS aptt_seconds, CAST(t1.thrombosis AS VARCHAR) AS thrombosis_flag FROM table_3 t3 JOIN table_1 t1 ON CAST(t3.id AS BIGINT) = CAST(t1.id AS BIGINT)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH abnormal_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM patient_aptt_thrombosis
  WHERE aptt_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND (aptt_seconds < 25 OR aptt_seconds > 35)
),
thrombo_by_patient AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(CAST(thrombosis_flag AS VARCHAR)) = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(CAST(thrombosis_flag AS VARCHAR)) IS NOT NULL
               AND TRIM(CAST(thrombosis_flag AS VARCHAR)) <> ''
               AND TRIM(CAST(thrombosis_flag AS VARCHAR)) <> '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonzero_cnt
  FROM patient_aptt_thrombosis
  GROUP BY patient_id
),
thrombo_neg AS (
  SELECT patient_id
  FROM thrombo_by_patient
  WHERE zero_cnt > 0 AND nonzero_cnt = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.patient_id) AS abnormal_aptt_no_thrombosis_count
FROM abnormal_patients ap
JOIN thrombo_neg tn ON ap.patient_id = tn.patient_id;
